title: Of Mootcombe's three toasts, only two of the sources (the recorder's guest-list, the chantry's rite-table) carry the '(as a Scholar)' tag; the third (Hedda's wassail at the Press Hearth) is a plain will-based ask with no Scholar tag at all, even though the task/game clearly treats all three as a matched trio.
